# env commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `config` | Configure environment display settings (label, type, color) |
| `list` | List available environments |
| `select` | Select the active environment for the current profile |
| `type` | Manage custom environment type definitions |
| `who` | Verify connection and show current user info from Dataverse |
